cut_k.note: Colour the dendrogram branches into k clusters (cut the tree at k). 0 = a single grey tree. Needs a tree drawn (cluster ≠ none).

annotations.note: Comma-separated sample-sheet columns to paint as categorical annotation tracks above the columns (needs a design / sample sheet).

quant_track.note: A quantitative side bar aligned to the rows: per-gene variance / mean, or log2 fold-change between the sample sheet's two condition groups.

split_by.note: A sample-sheet column to block-split the columns by (gaps + group headers; column clustering is dropped). Needs a design / sample sheet.

split_by_cut.note: Block-split the columns into the cut_k clusters from cutting the column dendrogram — unsupervised, no sample sheet. Needs cut_k >= 2; ignored when split_by is set.

catalog.summary: Clustered heatmap of marker / top-variable genes, row z-scored.
